title: Senior Software Engineer - C/C++ Networking & Security
teaser: We are currently hiring a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and development of secure networking solutions, focusing on VPN, PKI, and SD-WAN platforms. You will drive critical projects and mentor team members, ideal for candidates with extensive technical experience in networking and security.
description:
We, Security, Solutions and SDWAN Platform Infra, are a team passionate about building next-generation secure connectivity solutions across VPN, cryptography, PKI, and SD-WAN. Across on-prem, cloud, and SSE/SIG environments, we deliver secure, scalable systems and apply AI intelligence to improve security posture, automate certificate lifecycle management, optimize performance, and enable predictive monitoring at scale. Our work spans SDWAN Platform Infrastructure, crypto infrastructure, PKI systems, VPN technologies, SD-WAN secure fabric, and post-quantum security, powering millions of secure connections globally.

We are looking for Technical Lead to join team. You will be part of team building secure networking solutions in a high-impact, fast-paced environment. Your work will help build scalable, secure systems that enable site-to-site and remote access VPNs, certificate-driven trust models, cloud connectivity, and AI-enhanced secure SD-WAN architectures including initiatives in post-quantum security.

Your Impact

Lead the design and development of secure networking solutions across VPN (IPSec/IKEv2), PKI, cryptography, and SD-WAN Platform Infra

Architect systems that ensure high scalability, resiliency, and security posture

Drive multi-functional teamwork to deliver critically significant features

Improve performance, reliability, and operational excellence of distributed systems at scale

Influence technical direction and execution for high-impact projects that improve scalability, resiliency, security posture, and customer experience

Drive innovation in next-generation secure networking initiatives

Take complete ownership from conception to production release by demonstrating your ability to influence, facilitate, and work multi-functionally across teams

Drive the adoption of AI-assisted tools such as Codex to improve engineering productivity, automate development workflows, accelerate debugging, and enhance software quality across the team

Lead, mentor, and spread standard processes to other specialists on the team

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of deep technical experience across networking and security domains, large-scale, production-grade systems

Strong programming expertise in C/C++

Deep understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, distributed systems)

Validated experience in system design and architecture for scalable, reliable systems

Track record of leading critical projects end-to-end

Experience in embedded Linux software development

Ability to influence technical direction across teams

Good communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with IPSec VPN technologies

Embedded Linux system development, Yocto-based build system expertise, and cloud platform integration skills.

Understanding of PKI systems and certificate lifecycle management

Background in network security, SD-WAN, or secure connectivity

Exposure to cryptographic systems and protocols

Experience demonstrating AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity

Exposure to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) or cryptographic agility

Experience chipping in to networking/security standards (RFCs)
